description: Repo-scale (aspnet-helpdesk): enforce an agent's MaxOpenTickets cap from BOTH ticket-creation and ticket-reassignment mutation paths
prompts: Agents gain an optional `maxOpenTickets` field (a positive integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/agents and return it in agent responses. The invariant: an agent may never have MORE open tickets (status "open" or "in_progress", i.e. not "closed") assigned to them than their maxOpenTickets. This must be enforced from BOTH places that can newly assign a ticket to an agent: (1) POST /api/tickets, when `agentId` is given at creation, and (2) PATCH /api/tickets/{id}, when `agentId` is being changed to a DIFFERENT agent than the ticket's current one - both must reject with 400 if the target agent is already at capacity. Reassigning a ticket to the SAME agent it's already assigned to is a no-op for capacity purposes and must always be allowed.
name: add_csharp_helpdesk_agent_open_ticket_cap
